contexts.text: (In temptation) man seems to urge the Lord, especially by prayers, to...
Weeping and prayers () = their state of grief and despair.

They said it is strange that the Lord does not hear their prayers when they are praying... They cannot be heard... because they pray for themselves against all; and, when they pray in this way. Heaven is closed; for those in Heaven attend solely to the ends of those who pray. SE 1820.
The Word is to be scrutinized with a devout prayer to the Lord...
Those in temptations are wont to... betake themselves to prayers... not knowing that their prayers have no effect...
For this reason the prayers of those who are in temptations are but little heard... The Lord will not act in favour of the prayers against the end, which is salvation.
Under Piety, see this reference.
Under Incense, see this reference. AC 10295. AC 10298.

Who place all worship in adoration and prayers... Yet the Lord regards nothing else in the man who is in adoration and prayers than his heart; that is, his interiors as to love and the derivative faith; and therefore if these are not within the adoration and prayers, there is no soul and life in them...
The smoke of the incense = the elevation of the prayers...
Divine worship with those in the Celestial Kingdom, is not effected through confessions, adorations, and prayers, in the same way as with those in the Spiritual Kingdom. Explained.
The confessions, adorations, and prayers which are from man, are not (those) which are heard and received by the Lord; but they must be from the Lord Himself with the man...
The Angels said. The Lord Jesus Christ has heard your prayers, and has therefore sent us...

Which are the prayers of the saints () = thoughts which are of faith from affections which are of charity with those who worship the Lord from spiritual goods and truths. By prayers, are meant the things of faith, and at the same time those of charity, with those who utter the prayers; for prayers without these things are not prayers, but empty sounds.
Prayers = the things of charity and thence of faith in worship.
Those who... are somewhat moved by prayers uttered with affection...
See Pray.
Before... purification from evils, prayers to God are not heard. Illustrated.

Concerning the prayers of infants. - The prayers of infants are much more heard in Heaven than the prayers of adults, and still more fully than the prayers of those who have closed the way to interior things by thoughts of natural Things, and of the things of the memory; and still more fully than the prayers of those who are blinded, and thus have no faith... (Continued. See Lord's Prayer.)
In the other life their prayers for anyone are not granted, and not even those for themselves.
Concerning prayers. - Prayers to the Lord, if made from conscience, as a duty, are good; but if thereby something is obtained, or merited, it is... evil.
(It seems as if) pious prayers... inflowed into Heaven... But... it is a fallacy. Explained.

Concerning prayers. - Prayers effect nothing when they are such that we merely intend to deprecate our evils... Sins are not remitted except from the heart with a certain... internal pain, and thus an acknowledgement of filthiness, in which, and after, prayers avail... Otherwise, prayers, etc., rather confirm man. Explained.
Certain are wont to flee to prayers, at all evils and misfortunes... There is no aid from this.
(Infants there) learn prayers from their nurses through influx from Heaven.
Those who had believed that salvation consists in prayers... and had lived well. (See Last Judgment.)

Before whom I read the prayers customary in England before the Holy Supper... When they are reading these prayers in the churches they believe (them)... They afterwards consulted together about that prayer, and some wanted to change it... LJPost 212.
They eat with them by entreaty.
So that their prayers were for the end of self. Explained.
Everyone is allowed to approach the Lord with prayers...
When he prayed about any Thing, and did not obtain it, he was very indignant...
(In this cavern) are those who have devoted themselves to prayers...
For the Lord leads their prayings through Heaven to Himself.

Those also err who believe that they can dispose themselves for influx by prayers, adorations, and the externals of worship. These effect nothing, unless the man abstains from thinking and doing evils; and, through truths from the Word, he as of himself leads himself to goods as to the life. If a man does these things, he then disposes himself; and then the prayers, etc., avail before the Lord.
This worship (from spiritual good) is signified by the prayers of the saints... AE 325, Explained.
By prayers, in the internal sense, are meant all things of worship.

As prayers are not from the mouth, but from the heart through the mouth... it in said, Keep the door of my lips... And as David laments that evils still avail against him, he says, Because my prayers are as yet in their evils ().

Worship does not consist in prayers... but in the life of charity. Prayers are only its externals; for they proceed from the man through his mouth; and therefore such as is the man as to life, such are his prayers. Explained... Therefore, such as is the affection, such is the praying. Spiritual affection is what is called charity towards the neighbour... the praying is the proceeding. (Thus) the essential of worship is the life of charity, and the instrumental of it is gesture and praying; or, the primary of worship is the life of charity, and its secondary is praying...

As Divine worship consists primarily in the life of charity, and secondarily in prayers, therefore by prayers, in the spiritual sense, is meant worship from spiritual good; that is, from the life of charity...

Prayers are also mentioned in many places; but, as prayers proceed from the heart, and the heart of man is such as is his life of love and charity, therefore prayers = this life, and worship from it. Illustrated.
As prayers proceed from the life of charity, and are according to it, therefore, in order that it may be done according to the prayers, it is said, When ye stand praying, forgive...
As the prayers are such as is the heart of the man, and therefore are not the prayers of any worship if the heart is evil, it is said, If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear.
(Thus) praying, in the spiritual sense, is worship from love.
(Such) place piety in prayers, and not in life.
I will make them joyous in the house of my praying () = that He will gift them with spiritual truths: the house of praying, or the Temple, = the Heaven where are spiritual truths.
My house shall be called a house of prayers ()... As worship was carried on in the Temple at Jerusalem, it is called a house of prayers... prayers = worship.

By the prayers with which the incense should be offered () are not meant prayers, but the truths from good through which are prayers; for these are the things which are prayed with man, and in these prayers is man constantly when he is in a life according to these truths. That by prayers, in the Word, are meant the truths from good which are with man; and not the prayer of the mouth. Reference. AE 494.
That they cannot be heard on account of falsities, is signified by... he obstructs my prayers ().
